title: Implement ACP-based subagent spawning in ada-mcp
description:
Replace shell-based opencode_spawn with proper ACP (Agent Client Protocol) integration:

1. Add agent-client-protocol dependency to ada-mcp
2. Create ACP client class that handles:
   - Spawning OpenCode in ACP mode (opencode acp)
   - Session management
   - Streaming responses back
   - Tool call handling
3. Update opencode_spawn tool to use ACP
4. Add new tools:
   - opencode_spawn_acp: Spawn and get session ID
   - opencode_prompt: Send prompt to existing session
   - opencode_status: Check agent status
   - opencode_stop: Terminate agent session

Reference: Ada-Consciousness-Research/external/acp-python-sdk/examples/client.py

This enables true swarm orchestration from within ada-mcp!
